entries.title: Psalms 61:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. On a stringed instrument. A Psalm of David.>> Hear my cry, O God; Attend to my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 61:2
segments: From the end of the earth I will cry to You, When my heart is overwhelmed; Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

entries.title: Psalms 61:3
segments: For You have been a shelter for me, A strong tower from the enemy.

entries.title: Psalms 61:4
segments: I will abide in Your tabernacle forever; I will trust in the shelter of Your wings. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 61:5
segments: ¶For You, O God, have heard my vows; You have given [me] the heritage of those who fear Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 61:6
segments: You will prolong the king's life, His years as many generations.

entries.title: Psalms 61:7
segments: He shall abide before God forever. Oh, prepare mercy and truth, [which] may preserve him!

entries.title: Psalms 61:8
segments: So I will sing praise to Your name forever, That I may daily perform my vows.
